title: Lemon Salmon Orzo Skillet
seoTitle: Lemon Salmon Orzo Skillet | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: One-pan salmon with orzo, spinach, and capers
subtitle: One-pan salmon with orzo, spinach, and capers
description: Salmon sears in a large skillet while orzo simmers with lemon, spinach, and capers into a one-pan crew dinner.

steps.title: Sear salmon
steps.instruction: Heat 2 tbsp oil in large skillets over medium-high. Sear salmon skin-side down 4 minutes until skin crisps, flip, cook 2 minutes. Remove.

steps.title: Toast orzo
steps.instruction: Add 1 tbsp oil and orzo to pan. Toast 2–3 minutes, stirring, until grains smell nutty and turn lightly golden at edges.

steps.title: Simmer orzo in broth
steps.instruction: Add garlic, broth, lemon zest, salt, and pepper. Simmer 10–12 minutes, stirring often, until orzo is tender and broth mostly absorbed.

steps.title: Fold in spinach and capers
steps.instruction: Stir spinach, capers, lemon juice, and parmesan off heat until spinach wilts and orzo looks creamy, not soupy or stuck.

steps.title: Top with salmon and serve
steps.instruction: Nest salmon on orzo, cover 2 minutes to reheat. Salmon should flake at 125°F center, orzo glossy and al dente.

proTips: Stir orzo frequently—it sticks faster than long pasta in a wide pan.
Pull salmon early; it finishes during the covered reheat step.
Add halved cherry tomatoes with spinach for color and sweetness.
leftovers: Reheat gently with splash of broth—microwave on medium power.
Orzo salad cold next day with extra lemon.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Feels restaurant-plated but cooks on one burner line. Omega-3 plus carbs in one ladle portion.
mealPrepNotes: Use two skillets if station range is tight on space. Pat salmon dry before searing. Station: Sear salmon first, remove, finish orzo in same pan for flavor absorption. Station: Wilt spinach off heat so it stays bright green, not olive drab. Station: Return salmon on top for final 3 minutes to reheat without overcooking.
